process.label: 03 — PROCESS ⁄ METHOD
process.caption: Agile method (Scrum/Kanban) with SOLID, DRY and KISS — the numeral marks each phase.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.heading: Goals, users and scope
steps.copy: What problem we solve, for whom, and with which success metric. Stack, constraints and product narrative.

steps.title: Prototype
steps.heading: The key interaction, proven fast
steps.copy: Wireframes and a navigable prototype: we validate UX and architecture before the full build.

steps.title: Build
steps.heading: Design and code move together
steps.copy: Sprints with frequent demos. Frontend, mobile and backend in parallel — no endless handoffs.

steps.title: Launch + iterate
steps.heading: Ship it, measure it, tune it
steps.copy: QA, performance and real feedback. What ships gets iterated with data, not guesswork.
